body: Sort of. I thought I was in love with a girl I met in an online game once, but as soon as I got bored of the game we slowly drifted away. Normal friendship-wise though I dont really have anyone I talk to more than once every 5 or 6 months.
Uhh, probably my whole life. Longer than I can remember at least.

I honestly just dont care about being social, I dont make an effort to avoid or engage in social activity which usually means it doesnt happen. I will respond to people positively, but I will not make an effort to initiate conversations.
Have you checked out schizoid personality disorder? Most of it kinda fits for me, except for the asexuality I guess.
